name: Warg
identity: Low, broad, shaggy dark olive-brown Warg with large amber-gold eyes, pointed ears, gold inner ears only in front, dark broad muzzle, cream fangs, round ochre coat spots, small scratch/scar marks, raised dark shaggy shoulder/back FUR, four short broad paws and one long broad swept bushy tail. No collar, armor, saddle, rider, horns, golden dorsal spikes, wings or invented organs.

source_review.observed: Original seven renderers with shared left/right fore/hind sprites. Shoulder silhouette is raised dark fur, not hard gold spikes. Angry head has widened fang mouth; dead head tongue and blank gold eye.

anatomy_notes.Up: Axial rear, plain back of head and ears, far forelegs and near hindlegs, rounded heel backs with NO front toe divisions or visible claws; long tail attached to rear rump.
anatomy_notes.Down: Axial front, paired eyes and centered muzzle; far hindlegs and near forelegs, forward toes; long tail emerges behind far rump.
anatomy_notes.gait: Diagonal pair trot, short paw lift and small body bob; anchored shoulder/hip and tail roots.
anatomy_notes.occlusion: Body overlaps roots of far limbs; near paws remain distinguishable. Head overlaps neck, tail covers its attachment with correct depth.
